recognize_zh: 右上角為淋巴結周圍脂肪與纖維被膜，其下為被膜下竇與皮質；皮質由密集小淋巴球構成，間有較淡、帶較多細胞質的細胞形成斑駁區，未見結構破壞，是正常淋巴結邊緣的低倍樣貌。
features: Perinodal adipose tissue and fibrous capsule at the upper right
Subcapsular sinus beneath the capsule containing scattered pale cells
Cortex composed of densely packed small round lymphocytes
Irregular paler zones with larger cells and more cytoplasm imparting a mottled pattern
No well-formed germinal center in this field; no capsular infiltration by lymphocytes
describe_en: Section of lymph node at low-to-medium power shows perinodal fat, an intact fibrous capsule and an underlying subcapsular sinus. The cortex consists of densely packed small lymphocytes with interspersed paler zones containing larger cells with more abundant cytoplasm, producing a mottled appearance. No germinal center is included in this field, and there is no extracapsular extension or monotonous atypical infiltrate. Findings are consistent with normal lymph node cortex.

ddx.vs: SLL diffusely effaces the node with pale proliferation centers and obliterates sinuses, whereas here the capsule and subcapsular sinus are intact.
MCL shows a monotonous population of slightly irregular small cells with hyalinized vessels and cyclin D1 positivity, without the mixed mottled pattern seen here.
